question: What all-encompassing range from Śiva to Avīci must be contemplated in every place?
premises: Meditation is to be performed in place after place.
The object of meditation extends from Śiva down to Avīci.
This contemplation covers the full range of reality.
inference: One should meditate in every place on that reality which extends from Śiva down to Avīci.
